gloss: the only; the sole; the one and only

definitions.gloss: the only (one of its kind); the sole; the single
definitions.explanation: An attributive phrase meaning "the only" or "the one and only." Formed from the noun {唯一|ゆいいつ} ("the only one; uniqueness") plus the attributive particle の. Used to single out one item from a larger set as the unique instance of a quality.

examples.japanese: {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧だ。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧だ。
examples.english: This is the only means of solving the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}→伝統工芸：17478_dentoukougei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This village is said to be the only place in Japan where this traditional craft still survives.

notes:
A fixed attributive phrase built from the noun ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧ ("the only one; uniqueness") + the attributive particle ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. Always precedes a noun.

CORE PATTERN:
  {唯一|ゆいいつ}の + noun = "the only / sole + noun"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: the only way
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: the only means
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧: the only answer
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{例外|れいがい}→例外：03798_reigai⟧: the sole exception
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧: the only option
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧: the only difference
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧: the one and only hope
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}→唯一無二：20617_yuiitsumuni⟧: one and only; unique (a four-character idiom built on the same root)

FORMS:
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧: the only one (bare noun; used as a predicate, e.g., X ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧だ "X is the only one")
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}→唯一無二：20617_yuiitsumuni⟧: one and only; peerless; unique — a more emphatic four-character compound.
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の + noun: the ordinary attributive phrase.
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: practically the only
- X ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧だ: X is the only one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: the one and only — native-Japanese phrasing, slightly softer than {唯一|ゆいいつ}の.
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: the only person — specifically for people.
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の vs ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ simply counts "one"; {唯一|ゆいいつ}の asserts uniqueness.

USAGE:
{唯一|ゆいいつ}の is somewhat formal and emphatic. In everyday speech, speakers often soften it with ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or rephrase the sentence entirely. In writing, however, {唯一|ゆいいつ}の is the standard way to mark a unique instance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Though ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧ is historically a noun, the phrase {唯一|ゆいいつ}の is so common that some dictionaries treat it as a bound prenominal modifier. It cannot stand alone — *⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ is unnatural, as the meaning of "only" is already contained in the word.
